name: check-characteristics-mint-reasoned-fixture
_why: Planted for @SCN-CHR-003's @integration arm — THE ROUTE, TAKEN PROPERLY. `flakiness` is not a word fitness-functions.md carries, so the registry entry naming it would red under @SCN-CHR-001; what admits it here is a SECOND act in a key of its own, carrying a reason. `lint:complexity` beside it is a roster word needing no mint, so the arm proves the mint admits the word it names rather than the file it sits in. The reason is a whole sentence on purpose: an entry with nothing written against it is a config line again, which is the fault this route exists to be a way out of.
